conversationId.title: Conversation ID
conversationId.description: The unique ID of the conversation for which feedback is being recorded. This ID starts with '0dw'.

voiceCallId.title: Voice Call Id
voiceCallId.description: The unique ID of the voice call for which feedback is being recorded. This ID starts with '0LQ'.

feedbackResponse.title: Feedback Response
feedbackResponse.description: The user's feedback is true if the issue was resolved, false if it was not resolved.
